description: This file defines the CollectionSheetRequest class, a data transfer object used in the collection sheet feature of the Fineract project. It encapsulates details such as office ID, dates, locale, and bulk disbursement transactions.

classes.name: CollectionSheetRequest
classes.description: A serializable data transfer object that contains parameters for requesting collection sheet data, including office ID, date information, locale, and related disbursement transactions.
